scope: Local Node v24.15.0 read-only measurement; not Cloudflare CPU or memory measurement
dataBuildStatusAtMeasurement: 13 complete key shards (0..c), 78269 entries; d.json.tmp still existed and e/f were absent. Figures describe this partial build, not a frozen final registry.

retainedMemoryExperiment.method: Fresh node --expose-gc; GC; memoryUsage baseline; parse catalog and all 13 complete shards once and retain parsed values; GC; memoryUsage again
retainedMemoryExperiment.caveat: Node process RSS includes runtime and differs from a Cloudflare isolate. Repeated parse-loop RSS with uncollected garbage was discarded as a retained-memory estimate.

change: Every ordinary private request reads only manifest.json (maximum 16KiB). Only artist/character snapshot creation parses full catalog.json. Same-origin/binding observed version changes evict old shard generations; global cache cap is 16 shards.

checks: Five ordinary private GET/manual operations perform five manifest reads and zero full-catalog reads.
Artist snapshot creation performs a full-catalog read in addition to manifest validation.
Missing manifest returns503 without fetching a legacy full-catalog fallback.
Snapshot catalog version/readOnly disagreement returns503 before inserting a collection.
Same binding version v1 -> v2 -> v1 forces a new v1 shard read, proving old-generation eviction.
Original signed-session/SQLite CAS, idempotency, user isolation, collection/asset separation, limits and account deletion scenarios remain passing.

remaining: Final registry freeze, compiled Cloudflare bundle and actual staging/production isolate behavior are verified by the integration owner. Cold random ownership keys still require the relevant JSON shards; no new lookup format was introduced.
